note: South Africa, by the Department of Home Affairs' visa exemption list issued on 9 December 2025: holders of the ordinary passports it lists enter without a port of entry visa for 90 or 30 days (some 90 days a year in all, marked P/A); everyone else needs a visa from a South African mission. The list's ordinary-passport column is read; diplomatic, official and service passports aren't modelled.
